## California Unemployment Decomposition

```{r california-decomposition}
library(forecast)

# Load dataset
unemployment <- read.csv(
  "Unemployment in America Per US State.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Filter California
california <- subset(unemployment,
                     `State/Area` == "California")

# Sort by date
california <- california[
  order(california$Year, california$Month), ]

# Convert to monthly time series
ca_ts <- ts(
  as.numeric(california$`Percent (%) of Labor Force Unemployed in State/Area`),
  start = c(1976, 1),
  frequency = 12
)

# Fill missing observations
ca_ts <- na.interp(ca_ts)

# Original time series
plot(ca_ts,
     main = "California Unemployment Rate",
     ylab = "Unemployment Rate (%)")

# STL decomposition
stl_decomp <- stl(ca_ts, s.window = "periodic")
plot(stl_decomp)

# Seasonal adjustment
plot(ca_ts, main = "Seasonal Adjustment")
lines(seasadj(stl_decomp), col = "red")

# Classical decomposition
decomp_ca <- decompose(ca_ts)
plot(decomp_ca)

# Forecast next 15 months
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp, h = 15)
plot(f_stl)
```
